options.reason: The seven binary fault-indicator columns (Pastry, Z_Scratch, K_Scatch, Stains, Dirtiness, Bumps, Other_Faults) are joint outcomes describing the same steel-plate row, so the table was assembled for multi-fault detection over geometry/luminosity features and multilabel classification with all seven as targets is the defensible study.
options.title: multilabel

options.reason: If the aim is single-fault screening, Other_Faults (least imbalanced, 673/1268) is the outcome and the remaining fault indicators are leakage suspects since their values co-determine the plate's fault state.
